title: A Saurian Returns to the Nest
description: "Dad, if you've touched the stars, would you still want to return to the ground?"\n"Every creature that flies is born on the ground or in a nest, and they must all return whence they came."

dialogs.text: Nice view, don't you think? Perfect for flying too. Soaring through the skies, following the wind... It's an awesome feeling all around.
Indeed.
Ho there, warrior! If it's a trial flight you're after, feel free.
My father built this place for me, but I don't mind sharing it.
Thanks, I was just thinking about giving it a try.
You're welcome! Anyone who loves flying is a friend of Manyoya's! That's me, by the way.
You look a little young for the Saurian flying squad. Are you a reserve rider? Or are you training to become a warrior?
We're just passing adventurers.
Oh? I rarely see adventurers so passionate about flight. Until a moment ago, I thought you were training for the flying squad exam.
Soaring through the skies... Now that's a feeling you never forget.
Doubt you'll find a soul who wouldn't hold onto that freedom no matter what, and I'm no exception.
You sound like you're in the know. Are you from the flying squad?
Haha! I used to be! I'm retired now.
I flew for quite some years — and while that doesn't make me too old by most measures, I was a real veteran in the flying squad.
So when my physical condition fell off from where it used to be, it was time to say goodbye.
No need to pity me. Haha! I'm not even sad, though it is quite regrettable.
Our young Saurian riders have just started taking to the air, but I've already caught a shooting star.
Things won't be the same anymore, of course, and I won't get to spend most of my day in the sky, I still have a chance to soar up there.
So, that's why I'm here, reminiscing about the life I've given up.
Shame that flying solo is quite boring without the company of my squadmates.
Oh, yeah, how'd you like to fly with me? Our squad often had little competitions, just for fun.
The one with the highest score would get tossed into the air while the lowest would pay for our meal.
You Saurian riders are a tight-knit bunch, huh?
Yeah, everyone's amazing. We're both squadmates and rivals.
Ah, not that I'll ever get to enjoy that atmosphere again... Nor can I deny that my skills are on an inexorable downhill slide...
But even should physical strength decline and judgment dull, experience never stops stacking up.
So I might have retired, but that's just from the squad — not from the skies.
So, shall we compete? Think you can catch a veteran Saurian rider in the air?
We're in.
Huh. I was worried for a moment that you'd think me a freak for abruptly mentioning these things to a youngster like you. Thank goodness you didn't.
But let me know when you want to give it a whirl. Let's set this as our objective:

Ride your Saurian as far as you can along the designated course within the time limit. I'll help you keep score. The results are divided into 4 grades, and we'll count this as your win if you can beat the second-highest tier.
Let me know when you're ready to challenge me.
Let me think about it.
Thanks. I'll think about it when I'm free.
Hello there.
Not that easy, huh?
Our captain would be furious if word got out that we flying squad members could be surpassed by just any passing adventurer. Haha!
Alright, it's nothing to be upset about. I should be thanking you for keeping my pride intact, if anything.
You flew quite well, but it's still too soon for you to surpass me.
If you think you can do better, why don't you give it another try? You should never stop trying while you're young. Losing isn't a big deal anyway.
So, are we competing, then?

Ride your Saurian, and fly at full speed along the course, striving to get the highest possible score within the time limit. <color=#00E1FFFF>It counts as a win for you as long as you exceed the second-highest score tier.</color>
I'm ready.
Nice! Let's head to the starting point.
I need a little more time.
Of course. Just let me know when you're ready. Flying has always been about relaxing and having fun.
Not that easy, huh?
Our captain would be furious if word got out that we flying squad members could be surpassed by just any passing adventurer. Haha!
Alright, it's nothing to be upset about. I should be thanking you for keeping my pride intact, if anything.
You flew quite well, but it's still too soon for you to surpass me.
If you think you can do better, why don't you give it another try? You should never stop trying while you're young. Losing isn't a big deal anyway.

Ride your Saurian, and fly at full speed along the course, striving to get the highest possible score within the time limit. <color=#00E1FFFF>It counts as a win for you as long as you exceed the second-highest score tier.</color>
Hahaha! You were great! Guess it's true what they say, that the young are bound to surpass the old.
Even stars may fall, let alone people.
My time is over. Retiring happily was the right choice.
... Ah, but it's just so difficult to accept. I'm still young, I don't even have wrinkles. Why do I even have to retire?
How could my career be over so soon? I started falling before I could even experience what it was like to reach the top.
Had I known I'd have so many regrets...
Never mind. If I could do it all again, I would still make the same choices.
I would still do my best to join the flying squad, which isn't difficult given my skills. Then I'd wind up retiring at this age again.
I've done my best, and all I can do now is accept it.
I guess that's life. Many things are beyond our control, and if you dream of being a hero, perhaps you must accept that you can shine for but an instant.
Manyoya...
#Not to worry, {M#he}{F#she}'s a brilliant flier. You had this pitying look the whole time, so why the uneasy face now?
Haha! Life's full of surprises, and they'll come whether you accept 'em or not.
Consider it a pearl of wisdom from a retired Saurian rider. My issues are my own to solve. Don't let them ruin your mood.
I'm impressed. If only my siblings were as calm as you are.
You have siblings?
That's right. Two younger brothers, and unlike you, they're a chore and a half to get through to.
They're training their flying skills too— Well, no. Acomitl's just focused on running away from it all, so he might've been hiding instead.
Forget about those brats. I can see your talent, clear as day.
Try training a little more if you get the time. Who knows? The flying squad may come knocking at your door.
I'll try my best.
That's good to hear. I hope I'll catch you flying again. Good luck, young warrior.
I enjoyed flying with you! Let's do this again sometime —but until then, take care, young adventurer.
It's time for my Saurian to return to its nest. Shall I too descend from the stage in the skies?
Don't stop flying.
I guess you heard me mumbling to myself, huh?
I should make a trip home — haven't told my family about my retirement yet.
I'll have a bunch of free time soon, but I haven't figured out what to do with it.
Once I find my bearings, I'll have to face the next stage of my life.
So I should hear what my family has to say about it first. My father used to be in the flying squad, and he became a training master after retirement.
He's been on this path, so he's got to have some thoughts on the matter.
So, I'll be dismantling this place and taking it with me, but I'll leave the course here. Young warriors like you still need a place to train, after all.
Will we meet again, Manyoya?
I don't know. But no matter what choice I make, I don't think I can ever give up on the skies.
So as long as you don't stop flying, I think we'll meet again.
Until next time, then.
See you, young warrior.
Manyoya...
Oh, there you are.
